reviews.title: Performs great
reviews.comment: Great motherboard for my first PC build !! Easy to setup and bios was updated to newest edition . Everything you need if a lower priced motherboard
reviews.author: Darren Henry

reviews.title: Nice older budget board
reviews.comment:
Its an older AM4 board that I got to put some extra parts to good use. Paired it with an Ryzen 5 5500 and a Radeon 6650XT. Benchmarks around 90%. It has wifi and bluetooth built in. Was easy to get up and running.
Will it dazzle you on performance, no, but it does a solid job with games and work. If rgb is your thing, you wont have as many options. Overall, a nice starter board for a good mid tier build.
reviews.author: Derek H

reviews.title: MSI renowned quality
reviews.comment: This board has a great price point for the features it offers. 2 m2 slots on a lower end board like this is very rare. Let alone built in WiFi and BT. Great quality, good price, will serve well
